title: Consideration of Environmental, Social and Governance Factors in Investment Decisions of Singapore's Government Investment Funds
what_it_is: Consideration of Environmental, Social and Governance Factors in Investment Decisions of Singapore's Government Investment Funds

sections.label: GIC and Temasek sustainability investing
sections.summary: GIC and Temasek emphasise sustainability in their investment activities to generate long-term returns on a sustainable basis.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: While the Government does not prescribe how they invest, both emphasise sustainability in their investment activities.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The investment activities of GIC and Temasek are oriented towards generating long-term returns on a sustainable basis.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Both entities recognise that good sustainability practices are good for business and can have a positive impact on long-term returns.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Conversely, companies with poor sustainability practices carry business and reputational as well as environmental, social and governance risks.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: And that is why GIC integrates sustainability considerations holistically into its investment processes, in order to protect and enhance the long-term value of its investments.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Likewise, Temasek is committed to delivering sustainable value over the long term as a responsible investor.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: It takes a strong interest in not only understanding sustainability-related challenges but also the opportunities for innovation, business growth and new investments.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: And more than just considering environmental, social and governance factors when making decisions as an investor, asset owner and shareholder, Temasek is a strong advocate for sustainable economic and social development.
